notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes: [p]Hey Everyone, the [b]Demo for Tape 101 [/b]received a quality of life update which will be in the following:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Re-Worked Dialogue: [/b][/p][p]The dialogue system has been re-worked, therefore you can now [b]read & skip[/b] to the next dialogue with [b]LMB[/b] "Left Mouse Button".[/p][p][/p][p][b]Optimization:[/b][/p][p]We have optimized the game to run on older rigs for a better & smoother experience, the game now can run on [b]high-ultra settings[/b] on an [b]NVIDIA GTX 1650 [/b]targeting [b]50-60 FPS.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you guys for sticking around.[/p][p]-Suversa, Double H Productions[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes-1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we hope you are enjoying the Demo.
The following section are the patch notes for the update that we have uploaded, also keep in mind that this version will receive more [b]future updates[/b] alongside [b]localisation[/b], more will be talked about later.

Patch Notes:

[b]-Updated Disclaimer Interaction:[/b] Replaced the “Accept & Continue” button with a “Click Anywhere” interaction on the Disclaimer page for a smoother user experience.

[b]-Audio Overlap Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where Dr. Domoradzki’s dialogue (the scientist on the PC) overlapped with Dr. Sam David’s voice lines.

[b]-Extended Dialogue Display:[/b] Increased the on-screen duration of Dr. Sam David’s dialogue in the operation room area from 5 seconds to 8 seconds for better readability.

[b]-Enhanced Running Sound Variants:[/b] Added 9 new footstep sound effects during running, increasing the total from 5 to 14. This makes the running audio feel more dynamic, varied, and natural.

[b]-Relocated Dr. John's Note:[/b] Moved the note to a more accessible and linear location to ensure players don’t miss it during gameplay.



One more thing, guys report any bugs, suggest feedback in the [b]community hub [/b]section or join our Discord server, thank you!

[b]-Double H Productions[/b]

notes.title: Notes for the Demo.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, this is [b]Suversa[/b] from [b]Double H Productions[/b].

Some notes for our community & for future players who will be playing the Demo.

*Please keep in mind that this demo may be demanding on performance particularly on low to mid-range GPUs, and occasionally even on high-end rigs. The game is a mix between an immersive experience and traditional gameplay. However, this does not mean the game is unplayable, and it does not reflect the final version’s performance.

*This project is the work of a two-person studio. If you experience any issues, bugs, or rough edges, we appreciate you reporting them to us.

*In the near future, we’ll release an update that continues Chapter 1. That will be the final content for the demo. All updates and dev logs will be posted on our Discord server and Steam page.

*Your feedback whether positive or critical helps us improve. Every comment and a bit of support has a real impact, helping us keep going and give even more.


Lastly, join our Discord community and enjoy the game!
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/6TwYzmq3Xw

Excited to see on Monday.

-Double H Productions

notes.title: Demo Release & More
notes.notes:
As a two person studio, we are beyond grateful for helping us reach 1,000 wishlists your support means the world to us! To celebrate this exciting and motivational milestone, we’re thrilled to announce that a demo for TAPE 101: The Backrooms is on the way! The game features seven chapters, and the demo will let you experience Chapter 1 in all its eerie glory.

Before the official release, we’ll be hosting a playtest for the demo to gather early feedback and fine tune hidden areas waiting to be discovered. We’ll share details soon on how to sign up if you’re interested in being among the first to explore the unknown.

Stay tuned, and thank you again for your incredible support!

-Double H Productions
